① Player picks numbers → wallet signs buy_ticket (fee payer = buyer) → program moves 0.1 SOL into the Vault and mints the ticket NFT
② Keeper, after close: commit_draw (same tx as the Switchboard commit) → later reveal + settle_draw in one tx; cancel_campaign if the draw is stuck
③ System transfers: buyer → Vault on buy; Vault → treasury and Vault → winner on settle, signed by the vault PDA seeds ④ Core CPI: collection (create_campaign), asset (buy_ticket)
⑤ Program reads the randomness account: owner = pinned Switchboard id, key and seed_slot equal the stored values, value revealed ⑥ Treasury receives only the fee; its address always comes from Config
